name: PlaybookPanel, LearningDashboard, PromptEvolutionPanel

states.name: Tab Navigation
states.description: The three adaptive learning tabs in the Meta-Optimizer page tab bar: Adaptive Learning, Playbook, and Prompt Evolution.

states.name: Learning Dashboard — Stat Cards
states.description: The Adaptive Learning tab displays four stat cards at the top showing aggregate counts from the adaptive learning system.

states.name: Learning Dashboard — Trend Charts
states.description: SVG-based charts showing lesson growth, domain distribution, and helpfulness trends over the last 30 days.
states.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and data loaded

states.name: Learning Dashboard — Template Performance Table
states.description: Table showing verification template performance data with success/failure counts, confidence, and quality scores.
states.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab is selected and templates exist

states.name: Learning Dashboard — Error & Empty States
states.description: Error handling and empty states for the Learning Dashboard.
states.precondition: Adaptive Learning tab selected and data is being fetched

states.name: Playbook Panel — Header & Filters
states.description: The Playbook tab header with title, domain filter, status filter, and refresh button.

states.name: Playbook Panel — Severity Groups
states.description: Lessons are organized into three severity groups: Critical (red), Important (yellow), Minor (gray). Each group has an uppercase header with count.
states.precondition: Playbook tab selected and critical entries exist

states.name: Playbook Panel — Lesson Row Content
states.description: Each lesson row displays a DO/DON'T prefix, lesson text, category label, helpfulness ratio, and action buttons.
states.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

states.name: Playbook Panel — Lesson Actions
states.description: Interactive controls for managing playbook entries: activate, retire, delete with confirmation.
states.precondition: Playbook tab selected, status filter set to 'staged', at least one staged entry

states.name: Playbook Panel — Expanded Detail View
states.description: Clicking a lesson row expands it to show metadata and source run context.
states.precondition: Playbook tab selected and entries are visible

states.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Header & Filter
states.description: The Prompt Evolution tab header with title, domain filter, and refresh button.

states.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Domain Summary Cards
states.description: Summary cards showing per-domain GEPA optimization stats with total improvement.
states.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

states.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Run History Table
states.description: Table of GEPA optimization runs with columns for date, domain, old score, new score, improvement, and status.
states.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

states.name: Prompt Evolution Panel — Before/After Prompt Diff
states.description: Expanded GEPA run detail showing the old and new generation instructions side-by-side with score delta.
states.precondition: Prompt Evolution tab selected and GEPA runs exist

states.name: Auto-Refresh Behavior
states.description: All three adaptive learning panels auto-refresh on learning-update events and periodic timers.

states.name: Visual Design — Colors & Typography
states.description: Consistent dark theme design across all adaptive learning panels.

states.name: Learning Loop — Data Correctness
states.description: Semantic assertions verifying that the adaptive learning system produces correct, consistent data across its three panels.
states.precondition: Both Adaptive Learning and Playbook tabs have loaded data

description: Adaptive Learning system — three panels within the Meta-Optimizer page that display playbook lessons, curated examples, template performance, GEPA prompt evolution history, and learning trend charts. The system learns from every workflow run and injects lessons into future generation prompts.
